title: Name the fix when show --context has no --section
lead: `slicer show ID --context` exits 2 with "--context requires at least one --section". The message states the rule but not the fix, and the agent skill's own example pairs `--context` with `--section`.
findings_note: show s173 --json --lean --context failed with a usage error while reading the slice
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing the exit code or error code; making `--context` default to a section; changing `slicer sections`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: An agent that runs `show ID --context` alone gets a usage error and has to guess which section names are valid. The error can name the fix in the same line: pass `--section NAME`, and `slicer sections` lists the names. The exit code and the error code stay as they are.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py` (the `--context` check in `cmd_show`)
- `tests/test_ops.py` (the existing assertion on this message)
- `CHANGELOG.md`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. `show ID --context` without `--section` still exits 2 with error code `usage`, and its message still contains `--context requires at least one --section`.
2. The message also names `slicer sections` as the place that lists valid names, and shows `--section Implement` as an example form.
3. `show ID --context --section Implement` is unchanged.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Extend the message at the raise in `cmd_show` with the fix. Do not change the exit code, the error code, or when the error is raised.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: The failing tests pass, then `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests`, `slicer check`, and `git diff --check`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, including the re-rendered roadmap and a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased.
